name: Asou Keiko
source:
The protagonist’s biological mother. A beautiful woman with a ripe, voluptuous body in her prime.

Since her son grew up, she has had virtually no sexual relationship with her husband for the past few years.

She serves on the Committee for the Prevention of Harmful Environments for Youth and is in a position to regulate harmful sexual content.

Shocked to learn that her son is being bullied at school, she agonizes over the situation before finally taking him to the hospital.

The doctor tells her that she is responsible for her son’s phimosis, so she bathes with him and massages his penis every day.

During these sessions, her son’s hands reach out to her mature breasts and her crotch, which is thick with dark pubic hair.
